definition: Demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal.
exampleSentence: The supervisor insisted that all team members submit their progress reports by noon.

definition: Induce someone to do something through reasoning or argument.
exampleSentence: She persuaded her colleagues to support the green energy initiative.

definition: Confess to be true or to be the case.
exampleSentence: The spokesperson reluctantly admitted that production deadlines had been missed.

definition: State that one refuses to admit the truth or existence of.
exampleSentence: The minister firmly denied having participated in the controversial financial scheme.

definition: Say or do something to remove the doubts and fears of someone.
exampleSentence: The airline captain reassured passengers that the turbulence was entirely standard.
